fi-xiphophorus-variatus.title: Variatus Platy
fi-xiphophorus-variatus.summary: The variable platy, Xiphophorus variatus, is a livebearer native to the Atlantic slope of Mexico, with feral populations in several other countries. Most on sale are mass-produced in the Far East and…
rows: Omnivore. Omnivorous by nature, feeding on a variety of zoobenthos and detritus in the wild.
Originally endemic to the Atlantic slope of Mexico but introduced or feral populations now exist in several other countries, including Costa Rica , Colombia , the USA, Hawaii ,…
notes: Not critical but this species does appreciate a planted aquarium, and will be seen at its best if kept in this type of setup.
